source_documents.title: Photoexcitation Induced Twisted Intramolecular Charge Shuttle (TICS)

reference_evidence_units.quote: In TICS systems, the donor and acceptor moieties dynamically switch roles in the excited state as a result of ~90° intramolecular twisting
reference_evidence_units.subject: TICS fluorophores
reference_evidence_units.statement: Twisted intramolecular charge shuttle: donor and acceptor swap roles on ~90° twisting.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the TICS conformation is the global minima and the oscillator strength of the TICS conformation is almost zero, indicating that TICS is a dark state.
reference_evidence_units.subject: BODIPY 2 (analogue)
reference_evidence_units.statement: The twisted TICS minimum is dark (f ≈ 0).

reference_evidence_units.quote: BODIPY 5 (a close analogue of 2) exhibited low quantum yields
reference_evidence_units.subject: BODIPY 5

reference_evidence_units.quote: These observations indicated that the low quantum yields of 5 were related to molecular rotations.
reference_evidence_units.subject: BODIPY 5

reference_evidence_units.quote: We thus attributed the second excited state to the TICS state
reference_evidence_units.subject: BODIPY 5
reference_evidence_units.statement: 3.0 ps LE decay and a 78.3 ps state assigned to TICS.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Viscosity restricts the amino rotation and raises the emission.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Transient absorption shows LE → TICS conversion; the twisted charge-shuttle state explains the low yield.
